Splitting into 9 separate vaults needs a separate funded onyx account and a separate escrow deposit for each, so that the capital requirement multiplies while the influence does not. A 416 account operation therefore ties up 1 million dollars of idle capital. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
